headline: This law extends until January 24, 2028, the deadline by which the Peace Corps Commemorative Foundation may establish a memorial on federal land near Washington, D.C.
what_it_does: It extends the Peace Corps Commemorative Foundation's authority to build a commemorative work on federal land in the District of Columbia and nearby areas. The memorial would honor the Peace Corps mission and the ideals it was founded on. The bill changes the time limit for that authority, not the memorial itself.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 5, 2021; the extended authority runs through January 24, 2028.
